FPT.title: FutPythonTrader data
conditions: provider data available or explicitly unavailable
invariants: point-in-time reads do not use future data
failure_modes: parser drift changes history without version

WEB.title: Read-only web product
conditions: no business authority in the browser
failure_modes: stale data shown without quality state

STA.title: Backtest and statistical validation
conditions: outcomes and sampling rules are defined
invariants: software correctness differs from predictive validity
no profit claim from in-sample data

SEC.title: Offline security and isolation
outputs: authorized read response or controlled denial

PIT.title: Point-in-time temporal correctness (owner D4)
inputs: event, provider, acquisition and availability timestamps
invariants: no data later than decision time

MKT.title: Backtest outcomes and frozen configuration
invariants: same input and version give same result
